visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair and silver glasses, wearing a cream-colored short-sleeved button-down shirt and light-wash denim jeans, sits cross-legged on a large white bed. Behind him is a modern blue paneled wall and a dark open doorway. To his left, a shelf holds small decorative jars. He looks directly at the camera, gesturing with open hands as if explaining a concept. (2) He reaches toward the side of the bed and picks up several small rectangular cards. He holds one card up to the camera, revealing a yellow crescent graphic and printed text. He uses his right thumb to adjust his glasses while continuing to look at the lens and talk, maintaining a calm and sincere facial expression. (3) The camera cuts to an extreme close-up insert of the card held between his hands. A pink tab with the word 'PULL' is visible. His fingers gently slide the pink paper out of a slot in the yellow graphic, revealing hidden text. He repeats this action with three different cards, showing the inner messages clearly to the viewer. (4) The scene returns to the wide shot of the man sitting on the bed. He holds a small stack of the cards and gestures broadly with them as he concludes his talk. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the soft texture of his shirt and the clean environment of the room.
